dedupe_keys.name: arbolado en parques y zonas verdes de madrid municipal tree inventory yearly files

description: This dataset publishes Madrid's inventory of municipally maintained trees each year, split into historic, singular and forest parks and into green zones, districts and streets. The City of Madrid's directorate for water and green space management (Dirección General de Gestión del Agua y Zonas Verdes) is responsible for it; it was first published in August 2017 and last updated in June 2026. For each year there are files of trees, tree condition and tree stands (masas arbóreas) for parks and for green zones and streets by district, from 2017 onward; 2018 files for streets and districts are missing because of a change of municipal software. Coverage is the City of Madrid. Format and access: yearly downloadable files on the city's open data portal, which also offers an API. Licence: CC-BY-4.0; free. Caveats: only municipally maintained trees are included, and the formats were not checked file by file. Tree condition over time helps assess storm failure risk, heat mitigation and green infrastructure planning. Related catalogue records are the URBREATH 3-30-300 rasters, which include Madrid, and the Gomeznarro Park stormwater retrofit in Madrid.
